product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A platform feature that allows users to create and share links enabling customers to pay online using various payment methods.

product.name: Invoices
product.description: A tool to create professional invoices to facilitate faster payment collection from customers.

product.name: In-Person Payments
product.description: A service to accept card payments in person using a mobile device's NFC chip, keyboard input, or camera scanning.

product.name: Two Day Payouts
product.description: A payout service that transfers funds to merchants' bank accounts within two business days after payment processing.

product.name: Tap To Pay
product.description: A feature that allows seamless acceptance of in-person contactless card payments via mobile devices.

product.name: Teams
product.description: A service that permits multiple users within a business to process card payments using their individual devices.
